story: Washington made 22 threes, one short of the franchise record, led wire to wire and won its third straight, 116–96.
aria: Animated Short: Bilal Coulibaly's 3-pointer late in the third quarter, Washington's 18th three of the night, that made it 97–75 on the way to a 116–96 Wizards win over Orlando. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
